technical-summary: RSC08 S3: an engine started from a measured serving manifest admits the plan that manifest carries (expected plan and kv_backing_floor from engine_view, handed over by rad0009 to rad0011). The interim radiance --plan-check/--plan-check-floor-ppm flags and bc-serve --plan-check-args/--plan-store/--plan-key are deleted; bc-serve --write-manifest takes --measured-plan FILE to check, store and write the measured manifest from a measuring start's plan. rad0011's main() hook now runs after rad0009's manifest reader (before, a manifest-started measuring engine would have stripped --plan-memory first and refused its own unmeasured manifest). The launcher starts a helper layout's engine from the manifest alone and refuses --engine-arg and --ngram-device there until they are manifest fields.
user-summary-candidate: The radiance engine now checks its start-up memory plan from the serving manifest it starts from; the separate plan-check flags are gone.
